name: 陷阱大师
desc: 反转：场上1张陷阱卡破坏。（对象卡是里向的场合，变成表向那是陷阱卡则破坏。不是的场合回到原状。那张卡的效果不发动）
faq: This card can destroy a Trap Card on either side of the field. So if your opponent has no Trap Cards and no Set Spell or Trap Cards, you must destroy a card on your side of the field. If it is face-down Spell Card you must reveal it to your opponent, and it is not destroyed.
